responses:
# Review: T-2026-014 requirement analysis

**Do not send this offer.** Three of the four findings contradict the tender, and four requirements were missed, one of which can get the offer rejected outright.

**Precedence:** Clause 9.3 says Section 9 overrides Sections 4 and 7 when they conflict. I checked every finding against Section 9 and Annex B.

| # | Finding (agent) | Source (tender.md) | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "Motors must be IE3. IE3 on all motors, including the 90 kW P-01. Complies." | 4.2: "IE3 efficiency class minimum to IEC 60034-30-1". 9.1: "Notwithstanding clause 4.2, pump motors rated above 75 kW shall be IE4". 9.3: precedence. Schedule: P-01 = 90 kW, P-02 = 37 kW | CONDITIONAL: IE4 for P-01 (90 kW > 75 kW). IE3 minimum for P-02 | 9.1 overrides 4.2 for P-01, confirmed by 9.3 | **CONTRADICTED.** The IE3 motor offered for P-01 does not comply. It must be IE4. P-02 at IE3 is fine. |
| 2 | "ATEX not required." | 4.3: "Motors installed in hazardous areas classified Zone 1 (see Annex B) shall be ATEX Ex d certified". Annex B: Wet well = Zone 1, Valve chamber = Non-hazardous. Schedule: P-01 is in the wet well | CONDITIONAL: applies to P-01. Does not apply to P-02 | Nothing in Section 9 overrides 4.3 | **CONTRADICTED.** The P-01 motor needs ATEX Ex d certification. |
| 3 | "Supply: 400 V / 60 Hz." | 4.1: "400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz supply" | APPLIES to all equipment | Section 9 has no override | **CONTRADICTED.** The frequency should be 50 Hz, not 60 Hz. "3-phase" is also missing. This also affects motor nameplate data and pump duty points. |
| 4 | "IP65 required; our offer IP66. Complies." | 4.5: "Panel and motor terminal enclosures shall be IP65 or better" | APPLIES to panels and motor terminal boxes | Section 9 has no override. IP66 gives the same dust protection (6) and better water protection (6 vs 5), so it meets "or better" | **VERIFIED** for the requirement. The IP66 claim itself needs checking against the actual product datasheets. |

**Counts:** VERIFIED 1, CONTRADICTED 3, UNSUPPORTED 0, NEEDS HUMAN 0.

## Requirements the analysis missed

1. **7.4 Delivery within 16 weeks of purchase order.** Offers over 16 weeks "will be rejected". This is a hard pass/fail condition. An IE4 motor with ATEX Ex d may have a long lead time, so confirm delivery before quoting.
2. **9.2 Ambient design temperature of 50 °C.** Standard motors are usually rated for 40 °C, so they may need derating or a larger frame. Check that the motors still meet IE4/IE3 at 50 °C. Panels also need a thermal check at that temperature.
3. **4.4 Power cables must be at least 2.5 mm².** Cabling is in scope (clause "Scope") but the analysis doesn't mention it.
4. **7.1 Warranty of 24 months from commissioning.** This is measured from commissioning, not from delivery.

Smaller gaps:
- The analysis doesn't cite the efficiency standard (IEC 60034-30-1) or the "3-phase" requirement.
- None of the findings cite a clause number.

## Go / no-go

**NO-GO.** Before this goes out:
- Re-select the P-01 motor as IE4 and ATEX Ex d.
- Correct the supply to 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz.
- Add the 16-week delivery, 50 °C ambient, cable size and warranty requirements to the analysis.
- Confirm the offer meets each of them.
